summary: Quick visual retest at 360x800 of the iteration-27 items after the black and blood-red theme change. All 5 requested items pass. (1) Palette tiles are 44x44. Column 6 (Q6, Q12) ends at x=328 inside the 336px content edge at a 360px viewport, so nothing is clipped, and all 7 states render. (2) The English Proficiency and Logical Reasoning chips are #8A0F24 with white text (about 9:1) and Maths is #74747F with white text (about 4.6:1), both legible on the result Solutions tab. The Maths chip in the catalogue is legible. The chapter attempt has only 1 subject, so the attempt subject chips are hidden; the Q-pill uses the same subjectColor. (3) custom_amber #7D5F1E with white text is about 6:1, and 'Use · Free' and Rapid 'Next' are legible. (4) The import is now expo-router/native-tabs. After the restart the Metro log has no deprecation warning, the bundle compiles, and the web tab bar navigates Home, JEE, Tests, Mission and Rapid. (5) Smoke check passed: login → Home (continue-attempt banner) → Rapid lobby → store → solo session (cards load) → result Solutions, with no console errors. New minor regression: because amber is darker, amber used as TEXT on black is now about 3.1-3.4:1.
